description: Hey! I'm Kaya, a graduating M.S. Computer Science student interested in neuroscience, AI/ML in healthcare, and AI security. I spent 2.5 years in a CS PhD program, gaining research experience in machine learning, statistical modeling, and scientific visualization. I'm excited to tackle astronaut health monitoring. Looking for curious, collaborative people interested in software engineering, biomedical sciences, AI/ML, or UI/UX who are eager to learn, experiment, and build something awesome!
